Definition: Eljada, the name of two Israelites and of an Aramaean leader
BiblicalUsage: Eljada is the name of two Israelites and of an Aramaean leader. In 2 Samuel 5:16, the text says "and Eliada."
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Eljada matters because God knows His people by name — even the ones Scripture mentions only once.
